ac01.requirement: 运行中任务 A、随后 pending B 及 C 的受控序列，记录 A 是否被取消及 B/C 实际排队/替换结果，并提供隔离工作流运行 ID/事件记录

protocol.isolation: 使用独立并发组（如 concurrency-probe-${{ github.run_id }} 派生组）或隔离仓库，不影响生产 pages 组
steps: A：workflow_dispatch 触发长任务（如 sleep 600），进入 running
B：再次触发短任务（sleep 60），进入 pending
C：第三次触发短任务（sleep 60），观察 B 被取消替换、C 保持 pending
A 自然结束后 C 启动执行
记录三个 run ID、每次运行的状态事件时间线（queued/in_progress/cancelled）与 conclusion
protocol.expected: A 不被取消（cancel-in-progress:false）；B 被 C 取代（平台默认 pending 替换）；C 在 A 结束后运行
evidence_to_record: 每次运行的状态事件与时间戳
B 的取消/替换事件记录

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: 提供工件清单、来源、采集时刻/窗口、SHA-256及与冻结快照的关联；缺失项目继续明确标为未验证。
acceptance_review.reason: Inventory lists current frozen artifact hashes/windows and honestly marks eight missing categories; this satisfies inventory transparency, not source completion.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: 原始时间、queue三项、PR身份及attempt历史分别完成独立比对，并给出一致/差异/缺证据数量与身份明细。
acceptance_review.reason: Independent verified_consistent is zero in all four artifact categories; payload/CSV self-consistency is derived evidence and original timestamp/queue/identity/attempt proof remains missing.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: 用同一真实run的多个attempt证据比较原规则和REQ-014/015规则，输出历史受影响批次数及差异；合成300秒例子不能证明历史真实E2E。
acceptance_review.reason: Seven rerun batches have no same-run multiple-attempt raw records or persisted attempt starts; bounds and a synthetic 300-second example do not establish actual affected batches.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: 真实构建、部署工件和公开JSON的对应关系通过REQ-022核验；本地Pages模拟下载或旧站公开源码抓取不能替代此证据。
acceptance_review.reason: No real controlled merged build/deploy/public JSON correspondence is available; retained report explicitly states unverified.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: 运行中每日任务A、随后pending B及C的受控序列中，记录A是否被取消及B/C实际排队/替换结果，并提供隔离工作流运行ID/事件记录。
acceptance_review.reason: Controlled running A/pending B/C real event sequence and isolated workflow run IDs are absent; only a future protocol exists.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: 文档明确cancel-in-progress:false保护running，不能声称默认保留所有pending；测试不得以YAML字面值断言queued任务永不取消。
acceptance_review.reason: README/test naming now distinguish running protection from pending replacement; current static checks agree.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: 读取可取得的真实运行历史并记录是否影响每日全量更新；没有历史证据时仍标未验证，不推断已线上发生。
acceptance_review.reason: Actual workflow history is not read; report honestly remains unverified. Lack of a local remote alone cannot prove a repository was never pushed.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: 本轮不强制启用queue:max；如果以后要求保留所有排队任务，需形成明确的新运行策略及对应验收。
acceptance_review.reason: queue:max is explicitly deferred with a documented future decision; the requirement does not force enabling it.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: 记录精确Python/Node版本、命令、退出码、失败数及完整日志；相关测试全部通过。
acceptance_review.reason: Retained Python3.12.3/Node22.23.3 logs exist and match tails, but contain 255 Python tests before REQ050/051 additions and no source HEAD binding; they do not certify current HEAD. Fresh scoped tests here run Python3.12.14, bundled Node is24.19.0.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: 原有Python79/79与Node34/34只作为原环境基线，不替代3.12/22结果；新增测试数量不受原数量限制。
acceptance_review.reason: Original79/34 baseline is labelled historical rather than used as the target-version result.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: 有完整工件时原始审计在目标运行时运行；工件缺失不能因wrapper退出0而报审计通过。
acceptance_review.reason: Raw audit failures due to missing artifacts are recorded as not_passed/failed_missing_artifacts, not converted to passed from gate exit0.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: CI工作流声明版本、文档支持版本和交付验证结果一致。
acceptance_review.reason: Declared/support versions are3.12/22 and historical result matches those versions, but current-head same-version verification is incomplete and no exact code revision is recorded.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: 每个REQ及AC都有通过/失败/未验证/N/A状态、版本、输入和证据；截图生成或测试进程退出0本身不能替代验收。
acceptance_review.reason: The ledger derives all AC statuses from commit names and blindly copies each REQ status; hollow evidence, hidden associated tests and a missing delivering commit still produce195 AC passed.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: F01–F19和D10/P04等未验证结论全部映射，无源问题遗漏；19组问题拆分为多条需求不被误计成新增审查问题。
acceptance_review.reason: F01-F19, D10/P04 mapping, fixed counts and source hashes are structurally verified.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: 修复后的相关失败检查转通过并保持正确能力；不得删除记录、补零或放宽验收使结果通过。
acceptance_review.reason: Frozen failed checks are preserved, but no per-AC post-fix re-evaluation links every old failure to actual proof; fresh counterexamples remain despite all-commit pass.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: 真实快照、合成输入、静态规则、真实部署证据分别标注；238项检查不能直接合成来源准确率。
acceptance_review.reason: Input kinds are hardcoded by REQ/type; REQ040 is labelled real deployment although its records are local target-runtime tests and actual deployment is absent. Hollow evidence is accepted.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: 文档51个REQ编号连续唯一，每项至少3条带唯一AC编号的可验证验收标准；所有源结论有追踪表。
acceptance_review.reason: Document has51 unique consecutive requirements and195 uniquely numbered ACs with the required structure and tracking.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: 明确37条整改、3条补证、9条保持、2条交付的分类；“保持”是已有正确能力，“补证”不是已确认线上故障。
acceptance_review.reason: 37 remediation/3 evidence/9 preservation/2 delivery classifications are explicit and structurally checked.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: 需求来源文件SHA-256可核验，原审查报告、证据、业务文件未改变；所有本地文档链接有效。
acceptance_review.reason: Frozen source hashes and document baseline match; existing document validation covers local links and attribution; this audit does not change frozen evidence.

acceptance_review.acceptance_text: 总体验收结论只有必需目标与证据均完成时才标完成，缺原始证据/真实历史仍保留未验证。
acceptance_review.reason: check_overall demands51 passed/zero unverified while source evidence is incomplete; truthfully markingREQ038/039 unverified is rejected. Document overall verified is a structural result, not delivery completion.

highest_risk_findings.title: Commit-based ledger certifies missing and hollow evidence
Warm daily refresh fails on the restored old manifest before stamping new bundle
Manifest file omission suppresses postdeployment snapshot verification
Coverage denominator drops derived-only evidence and mishandles duplicate identities
Invalid raw queue components accepted as numeric values
Missing artifact exception reported failed instead of source-unverified

limitations: No actual workflow triggered; no collection, deployment or network write occurred.
Scoped tests and controlled fakes prove local behavior only. Real original artifacts and GitHub run IDs remain absent.
Existing runtime records are reviewed as historical logs and have no source revision binding.
No production file or frozen evidence was changed; root handles one audit-only Git commit.
